whats_new_task_labels_body: Tag Tasks as Bug, Design and more from their popup, then filter the board by label.
whats_new_artifacts_body: Agents can now deliver docs, interactive web pages, and files. Annotate any element for your Agent to iterate on, switch versions, and share in a click.
whats_new_agent_usage_body: Open the Usage tab on any Agent profile to track effective tokens, cache hit rate, per-day drill-downs, context window usage, and model share across Today, 7d, 14d, or 30d.
